item.description:
### Added
- Nodex's Dock icon now shows how many chats are unread. It counts the same chats the sidebar marks unread across every Project, updates as soon as you read one anywhere, including on your phone, and clears when Nodex closes. Turn it off with Badges in Nodex's notification settings in System Settings. - Get Nodex Mobile from its public TestFlight beta on iPhone, or download the Android app from nodex.jyu.app/download. Every Nodex release now ships the phone app with the same version, so the phone and the computer it pairs with stay able to talk; TestFlight keeps the iPhone app current, and a newer APK installs over the old one without losing your pairing. - Each Nodex window is now named after what it shows, so you can tell windows apart in the Window menu, Mission Control, the Dock and window switchers. A chat window shows the chat and its Project, such as `Fix flaky E2E — nodex`; a Project, Page or Database window shows its name; and titles follow renames and Page title edits as they happen. On Windows the title ends with Nodex.
### Changed
- Nodex Mobile clears notifications for chats you've already read on your computer. As soon as the app connects, and whenever your chats change while it's open, notifications for chats that are read, archived or gone from your chat list leave Notification Center. - Your phone now hears from Nodex only when you're away from your computer. A chat you're watching on the desktop no longer buzzes your phone. The phone is told at once when the computer's screen is locked or nobody has used it for five minutes, and otherwise only if you walk away before touching the computer again. Answering, opening the chat anywhere, or a newer notification in the same chat withdraws one that is still waiting. A chat open on your phone no longer raises a desktop notification or turns unread, and opening it there clears its desktop notifications. A locked screen counts as out of sight on the desktop too, so chats that finish while it is locked turn unread and notify as usual. Chat reminders now reach your phone as well.
### Fixed
- Folders in the Files tree collapse again when a folder inside them is open. Previously the open folder inside kept reopening its parent; now it keeps its own state and is open again when you reopen the parent. Large folders also show a loading row until their entries arrive, and scrolling long folders no longer slows the Files panel. - Your phone no longer says a chat finished while it is about to continue with a queued message or delegated results, and no longer sends a finish and a question for the same moment. Phone notifications now follow exactly the same rules as desktop notifications.
